in_marathi.name: Irfankhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Irfankhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Irfankhan is derived from the Sanskrit and Hindi words 'Irfana' meaning lion and 'Khan' meaning ruler or chief. This powerful and courageous name is perfect for a little boy destined for greatness.
